title: The Dead Star That's Broadcasting Our Own Radio Signals Back at Us
hook: A dead star is reflecting Earth's old radio broadcasts back at us—and the delay is exactly 66.6 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: The specific number triggers pattern-recognition paranoia, and the idea of our own signals being weaponized or studied is deeply unsettling.

title: The Asteroid That Changed Course to Hit a Secret Military Satellite
hook: An asteroid changed its trajectory in 1985—and hit a classified military satellite no one was supposed to know existed.
why_this_can_go_viral: Implies intentional targeting and a government cover-up, tapping into conspiracy theories with a real event hook.

title: The Dark Matter Vortex That's Draining the Sun's Energy
hook: A dark matter vortex near the Sun is siphoning its energy—and NASA has been tracking it since 1998.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines the Sun (universal concern) with an invisible cosmic predator, creating immediate existential dread.

title: The Classified Shuttle Mission That Found a Hole in the Sky
hook: A secret 1991 shuttle mission discovered a hole in Earth's magnetic field—and something came through.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suggests a breach in Earth's defense and an unknown entity entering, which triggers primal fear of the unknown.

title: The Extinction Event That Erased All Life—Except the Deep Sea
hook: An extinction event 250 million years ago wiped out 96% of species—but deep-sea creatures survived and have been evolving in darkness ever since.
why_this_can_go_viral: The deep sea as a refuge from apocalypse is mysterious and visually compelling, and hints at unknown creatures.

title: The Star That's Eating Its Own Planets—and Growing a Toxic Atmosphere
hook: A star consumed its own planets and now has an atmosphere of vaporized rock and metal—and it's heading our way.
why_this_can_go_viral: Anthropomorphizes the star as a predator that consumes its own children, making it instantly memorable and threatening.

title: The Fermi Paradox Toothpaste—We're Smearing Ourselves Across the Galaxy
hook: The most likely answer to the Fermi Paradox? Advanced civilizations eventually smear themselves across space as a thin layer of biological goo.
why_this_can_go_viral: The grotesque, unexpected imagery ('toothpaste') makes it highly shareable and memorable.

title: The Secret Soviet Telescope That Saw Alien Megastructures in the 1970s
hook: A classified Soviet radio telescope detected megastructures near a star—then the entire program was erased.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines Cold War secrecy with the most tantalizing possible alien discovery, creating a perfect conspiracy story.

title: The Comet That Stinks of Rotten Eggs and Death—and It's Getting Closer
hook: A comet reeking of ammonia and hydrogen sulfide is approaching Earth—and its smell is the least terrifying thing about it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The sensory detail (smell) makes the threat feel real and immediate, triggering disgust and fear.

title: The Dark Matter Egg That's Hatching Inside the Moon
hook: The Moon has a hidden dark matter core that's growing—and it's about to hatch.
why_this_can_go_viral: The word 'hatching' creates a visceral, alien-birth horror that fits the cosmic niche perfectly.

title: The Asteroid That Hit the Moon—and Revealed a Hollow Structure
hook: When an asteroid struck the Moon, sensors detected a hollow ring—as if the Moon has an empty chamber inside.
why_this_can_go_viral: The hollow Moon theory is a classic conspiracy that still captivates viewers, and 'chamber' implies artificial construction.

title: The Classified Air Force Program That Detected a Portal Opening Near Mars
hook: In 1998, a classified Air Force sensor detected a gravitational anomaly near Mars—consistent with a portal opening.
why_this_can_go_viral: Portals are a massive curiosity trigger, and linking a real military program to one near Mars feels credible and terrifying.

title: The Extinction That Came From Inside—Earth's Core Erupted and Killed Everything
hook: An extinction event wasn't caused by an asteroid—it came from Earth's core suddenly reversing and erupting through the crust.
why_this_can_go_viral: Subverts the classic asteroid extinction narrative, making viewers feel betrayed by Earth itself.

title: The Star That's Pulsing in Morse Code—and It's Saying 'RUN'
hook: A star is pulsing in perfect Morse code, and the message translates to a single word: RUN.
why_this_can_go_viral: The single-word message 'RUN' is the ultimate hook—simple, universal, and deeply threatening.

title: The Rogue Asteroid That's a Dead Alien Probe—Still Broadcasting
hook: An asteroid in a strange orbit is actually a dead alien probe, and it's still broadcasting a signal we can't decode.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines the menace of an asteroid with the mystery of alien technology, creating a double-layered intrigue.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer in the Ice—Ancient Bacteria That Silence Life
hook: Antarctic ice cores contain ancient bacteria that emit a signal that sterilizes planets—and it's still active.
why_this_can_go_viral: Implicates bacteria as the great filter, turning a microbe into a terrifying cosmic weapon.

title: The Rogue Black Hole That's Orbiting Earth—Undetected for 50 Years
hook: A black hole the size of an atom has been orbiting Earth since 1972, and it's slowly consuming our planet from the inside.
why_this_can_go_viral: A hidden predator inside our planet is a classic horror trope, and the specific year adds pseudo-credibility.

title: The Secret Space Telescope That Photographed a Face on Jupiter
hook: A classified space telescope captured an image of a human-like face on Jupiter's surface—then was immediately decommissioned.
why_this_can_go_viral: Pareidolia (seeing faces) is deeply human, and the government cover-up angle makes it irresistible.

title: The Comet That's Traveling Backward in Time—According to Its Orbit
hook: A comet's orbit suggests it's moving backward in time—and it appears to be getting younger, not older.
why_this_can_go_viral: Time travel always goes viral, and applying it to a physical object creates a reality-bending mystery.

title: The Extinction Event That Was a Test—Someone Wiped Us Out on Purpose
hook: New evidence suggests a past extinction event was artificially triggered—as if someone tested a weapon on Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: Transforms a natural disaster into an act of cosmic warfare, which is both terrifying and deeply intriguing.

title: The Strange Signal That Matches the Frequency of Human Fear—Exactly
hook: A signal from deep space matches the brainwave frequency of human fear—as if something is broadcasting terror at us.
why_this_can_go_viral: Implies an external force is manipulating human emotion, which is the ultimate loss of control and deeply viral.

title: The Classified 'Project Black Star'—A Secret Colony on the Dark Side of the Moon
hook: A classified project established a secret colony on the far side of the Moon in 1969—and they've been in isolation ever since.
why_this_can_go_viral: The Moon colony conspiracy is evergreen, and adding 'isolation for decades' creates a dark, claustrophobic narrative.
